author: Jordan B Peterson
description:
What does it mean to actually live your life, not just survive it? In this lecture, Dr. Jordan B. Peterson explores the story of Abraham and what it reveals about identity, sacrifice, and the call to adventure. Why do people with everything still feel empty? Why does comfort, without purpose, corrupt rather than satisfy? And what does it actually cost you to keep playing it safe?

Peterson also digs into what marriage and parenthood really demand. Commitment isn't a cage. It's the condition for becoming someone worth being, and why the people who take it seriously end up with more, not less.

This is a lecture about what it takes to become who you're supposed to be, and why most people never do.

This lecture was filmed in Boston, Massachusetts, on June 5, 2024.
